entry.intro: Three to seven players. Play cards face down and claim they are the right rank, telling the truth or lying, and call out anyone you think is cheating. Computer players can fill any empty seats.

leaveConfirm: A computer player takes your seat if you leave.

lobby.share: Share this code, or the invite link, with your friends. Empty seats can be filled by computer players.
lobby.dealExtra: {players} players: {packs}, {cardsEach} cards each (and {count} player gets one more). | {players} players: {packs}, {cardsEach} cards each (and {count} players get one more).
lobby.hostOnly: Only the host can change these.

status.wins: {name} gets rid of every card and wins.
status.lastCards: {name} has played their last cards. Call Cheat, or say you believe them.
status.yourLastPlay: That was your last play: waiting for the others to accept it.
status.waitingDecide: Waiting for the others to decide about {name}'s last play.
status.yourTurn: Your turn: play 1 to {max} cards and claim {rank}.

status.playing: Playing {count} card as {rank}. | Playing {count} cards as {rank}.
status.pick: Click the cards to play, then press the button on the table. They need not really be the rank you claim.
status.callLie: {caller} called Cheat on {accused}: it was a lie, so {picker} picked up {count} card. | {caller} called Cheat on {accused}: it was a lie, so {picker} picked up {count} cards.
